_comment: Actual macOS candidate native bytes and original source/notice inputs; final rebuilt XPI/source-ZIP delivery is separate. Original files remain unchanged.

limitations: Existing Linux/Windows source choices and hashes are unchanged. Mac scope is based on actual observed versions, verified native recipes and matching source-lock input supersets.
Exact ONNX Runtime native revision 6af1a93 was not available from the official tag/commit endpoints; no different source is substituted.
Tiktoken compiled transitive versions and some prebuilt-wheel compiler/vendor details remain unknown, not additional legal or execution gates.

cpython.systemLinkScope: Apple libSystem/zlib/libedit/ncurses/panel and framework versions are not inferred from Linux recipes. Tcl/Tk dynamic links are marked system in PYTHON.json but originate in this standalone build.
cpython.berkeleyDB: No Berkeley DB linkage is declared by this macOS full-build metadata.
cpython.interpreterLinkScope: Original CONFIG_ARGS includes --enable-static-libpython-for-interpreter as well as --enable-shared; a shared-libpython label alone does not establish an interpreter dylib requirement.
cpython.upstreamNativeScope: Every interpreter native file actually shipped matches the verified original stripped archive. Unshipped GUI/libpython payloads are not asserted as shipped.

configurationBinding.fullMetadataFlagFormatting: Original full JSON and installed sysconfig CONFIG_ARGS differ only in whitespace within flags; both original values are retained.

opencv.noticeScope: Actual codec/SoftFloat notices plus original Carotene/Tegra-HAL BSD blocks and reported FlatBuffers source license; the pinned archive supplies full source files.

runtimeMetadataConsistency.scope: Refresh metadata only during main-task hydration; keep actual native bytes unchanged.

additionalNotices.scope: Original publisher license or unedited leading license block. FlatBuffers is a reported build input, not an assertion of compiled usage.

opencv.versionControlScope: Build-information f75f138 names the enclosing PaperBridge checkout, not the upstream OpenCV Git revision; source identity is the verified 4.12.0 archive hash.

remainingDeliveryWork: Main-task hydration must refresh OpenCV runtime extensionBytes so existing inventory/source selection recognizes the verified 4.12.0 build.
Main task rebuilds final bundled/local XPIs with these notices from the same native bytes, then binds/verifies the final corresponding-sources ZIP.
unknownBuildDetails: ONNX Runtime source revision 6af1a93 was not retrievable; exact native source/build closure remains unknown.
Tiktoken compiled transitive versions, Rust compiler versions and unreported prebuilt-wheel compiler/optional-link details remain unknown.
candidateBinding.scope: No source-ZIP check against the pre-notice CI XPI or local native execution is performed. CI CPU inference is retained evidence, not Zotero acceptance. Unknown build details are not generic gates.
